PARA.TITLE: SRS Side Airbag & SRS Curtain Shield Airbag Outline

ITEM.PTXT: The system consists of the SRS side airbags, SRS curtain shield airbags, side airbag sensors, rear side airbag sensors, center airbag sensor (computer), etc.

ENTRY.PTXT: Consists of an inflator and a bag. The inflator generates gas in response to the ignition signal from the center airbag sensor (computer), instantly inflating the bag and reducing and absorbing the impact on the occupant's chest.

Consists of an inflator and a bag. The inflator generates gas in response to the ignition signal from the center airbag sensor (computer), instantly inflating the bag and reducing and absorbing the impact on the occupant's head.
Located in the combination meter; illuminates to warn the driver when there is a system malfunction.
Side Airbag Sensor, Rear Side Airbag Sensor
Detects the deceleration in a collision, performs ignition judgment and sends an ignition signal to the center airbag sensor (computer).

Performs ignition judgment based on the signals from the side airbag sensors and rear side airbag sensors, and sends ignition signals to the SRS side airbags and SRS curtain shield airbags. When there is a system malfunction, the system can be diagnosed by switching to diagnosis mode.
